worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.summary: Condenses its own life-force into a dragon breath and spits it as a forward cone: every foe inside takes the draconic power once and is carried along the breath. Power falls with the user's remaining health, peaking at full HP; sacrifice style spends extra health to boost it.
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.use.0: Pierce a line of foes in one breath
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.use.1: Deliver the biggest forward breath at full health
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.use.2: Push a whole column of foes out
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.use.3: Trade health for a desperate burst with sacrifice style
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.descripti: Breathe a cone that deals about %1$s special damage once to each enemy within it, reaching %2$s blocks across a %3$s-degree angle. Damage falls with your remaining HP; the target’s Special Defence, type matchup and critical hits are resolved on impact.
A hit target is pushed about %1$s blocks along the breath (blocked by terrain); the wind-up is about %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.sacrifice: Sacrifice style: the breath deals ×1.3, but the cast drains about %1$s of your maximum health (it can finish you), with a slightly longer wind-up and cooldown.
Reserved style: no health drain, at lower breath power.
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonenergy.preferenc: On: the breath deals ×1.3, but the cast drains part of your maximum health (more dangerous at low HP) and can finish you, with a slightly longer wind-up and cooldown; off (reserved) spends no health at lower power.
Beyond this the companion walks in instead of breathing; higher opens from farther away but the cone more easily catches a single foe.
On: the companion raises Dragon Energy when more foes line up beyond the target, to pierce a whole column; off keeps the normal attack order.
With sacrifice style on, the companion stops breathing below this health fraction so the drain cannot empty it. Higher is more cautious.
